children: Telomir Pharmaceuticals announced a peer‑reviewed preclinical study showing Telomir‑Zn restored visual function and retinal structure in an AMD model.
Peer‑reviewed study published in International Journal of Molecular Sciences reports Telomir‑Zn improved visual performance after 14 days of oral treatment.
Telomir‑Zn reduced retinal degeneration and restored thickness across multiple retinal layers, including outer/inner nuclear and ganglion cell layers.
Treatment lowered mitochondrial oxidative stress and increased relative telomeric DNA content dose‑dependently toward healthy profiles.
Mechanistic data show Telomir‑Zn reduced labile intracellular Fe2+, increased intracellular zinc and inhibited Fe2+‑dependent KDM enzymes.
Company remains clinically focused on oncology with an FDA‑cleared IND for a Phase 1/2 TNBC trial; retinal findings suggest broader biological relevance.
